verdict: SYNERGY (coverage): routing each gene to its specialist nearly doubles coverage (2526→4082 genes) while effective per-gene accuracy 0.77 stays at/above the best single modality (0.71). Physics and data are blind in different places, so the union is broader without going wrong. CAVEAT: the pooled AUC 0.93 is base-rate-inflated (separates metabolic-vs-screen populations) — 0.77 is the honest number, not 0.93. Naive pooling scored 0.62; calibration + routing is what makes it work.
